title: Shape Detective
summary: Solve chalkboard mysteries with shape clues and spatial words.
description: Open a chalkboard case, listen for shape properties, search for secret spots, and place shapes using spatial words.
learningGoals: Identify circles, triangles, rectangles, squares, and hexagons by their properties
Understand inside, above, between, below, and beside
Act on spoken spatial directions by placing one shape relative to another
interactionModel: Tap shape evidence, drag a magnifier, and drag or tap-tap a shape into a generous spatial target.
feedbackModel: Warm spoken modeling and chalk sparkle on success; gentle scuff and a precise clue on a miss; no timer or failure state.

modes.title: Shape Clues
modes.skill: identify 2D shapes from sides, corners, and curves

modes.title: Secret Spots
modes.skill: understand spatial language while searching a scene

modes.title: Chalk Map
modes.skill: place one shape using a spoken spatial relation
